issues.description: The problem statement requires set_pixel to receive x in EAX, y in EBX and the RGB color in ECX and to write that color to the computed pixel address (while preserving registers except EAX). The solution's set_pixel computes the correct address but stores EDX into memory (mov [eax], edx) instead of storing ECX, thus ignoring the specified color parameter and contradicting the required behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the implementation to store the color from ECX into the computed address (e.g. replace 'mov [eax], edx' with 'mov [eax], ecx') and ensure the function preserves other registers as required by the specification. Verify that the implementation uses the ECX input as the pixel value.
